_doc: Stream W (Expansion 1). Vharlen's own wayside dressing — the island's answer to data/vignettes/wayside.json, same record shape (id, name, radius, biomes, lore, props) and read the same way by the placer's boring-walk fillers when it dresses a Vharlen zone. Props come ONLY from data/vignettes/vharlen-props.json (island ids + the neutral kit lists); no Torbor kit pieces, no trees (standing palms and ferns are island props). `biomes` = the baked island's World Forge keys this fits (empty = anywhere).

kinds.name: Rim Keeper Waymarker
kinds.lore: A basalt column banded in red ochre. The Rim Keepers set one wherever the trail could kill you. There are a lot of them.

kinds.name: Basalt Cairn
kinds.lore: Six-sided stones stacked like cut cheese. The island makes them that shape for free, so everybody stacks them.

kinds.name: Pilgrim Post
kinds.lore: A pole knotted with grey and red ribbons, one for each pilgrim who passed on the way up the mountain. Grey for asking, red for thanks. Mostly grey.

kinds.name: Ash Shrine
kinds.lore: Stacked slabs, a bowl of grey ash and red handprints. The Slagborn pray here. The handprints are fresh.

kinds.name: Offering Bowls
kinds.lore: Two stone bowls of ash set at the trail edge. Islanders drop a pinch of their own hearth in as they pass, so the mountain knows who is walking on it.

kinds.name: Fallen Ironpalm
kinds.lore: An ironpalm lying where the wind put it. The wood is so hard nobody has bothered to cut it up. Nobody ever will.

kinds.name: Salamander Skull
kinds.lore: A salamander skull the size of a handcart, bleached white. Whatever it ate, it ate a lot of it.

kinds.name: Buried Urn
kinds.lore: A clay urn sunk to its shoulders in ash, lid still on. Old people out here were buried standing up, so they could keep an eye on things.

kinds.name: Floats on a Post
kinds.lore: A driftwood post wrapped in torn net, green and amber glass floats caught in it like fruit. The sea keeps the lost ones.

kinds.name: Somebody's Fire
kinds.lore: A ring of red scoria with a fire still going in it. On this island you do not need wood to keep a fire. You need the ground to stay angry.

kinds.name: Reed Screen
kinds.lore: A reed screen on two posts, set against the wind that brings the ash. The ash came round the side.

kinds.name: Mooring Post
kinds.lore: A post sunk in black sand with a coil of rope on it. The canoe it held is gone. The knot is still very good.

kinds.name: Wall in the Drift
kinds.lore: The top of a red wall poking out of an ash drift, a window still in it. Somebody had a view. Now the view has them.

kinds.name: Burned Stand
kinds.lore: One tree burned black and still standing, a heap of beams at its foot. The fire ate the house and left the tree as a receipt.

kinds.name: Fern Gate
kinds.lore: Two tree ferns either side of the track, leaning in to touch. The Vharl say walking between them washes the ash off you. It does not.

kinds.name: Glass Spill
kinds.lore: Black glass broken all over the ground and a heap of cores somebody meant to come back for. Watch your feet. Watch your hands. Watch everything.

kinds.name: Slag Totem
kinds.lore: A stake hung with black slag and a red rag. Slagborn mark where they have been. They are not shy about it.

kinds.name: Sulphur Spill
kinds.lore: A heap of yellow sulphur dropped by the track. Somebody was carrying too much, or running.

kinds.name: Glass King's Pillar
kinds.lore: A fallen pillar inlaid with black glass. The Glass Kings put their names on everything. The wind has been taking them off.

kinds.name: Ironpalm Stumps
kinds.lore: Three ironpalm stumps cut flat. It takes a day and two axes to fell one. Whoever did this was paid well, or very stubborn.
